comment: Reviewed fallbacks for packages whose tarball/install tree has an SPDX id but no LICENSE/COPYING file. Missing both on-disk files and a row here is fail-closed. This is not a license-policy allowlist (#1225 deny.toml / check_npm_licenses.mjs remain the policy).
